race.comment: JE REVE (3) was just out of the money two runs back then again missed the frame last start over 1200m at Sunshine Coast, beaten 3.5 lengths into fourth. Drawn to get all the favours from the inside alley and no surprise to see him right in the mix. INQUISITOR (2) was never really a threat when resuming last start over 1200m at Sunshine Coast, finishing 8 lengths from the winner in tenth. Fitter now and the blinkers come off. Gets some weight relief with the claim and expected to run well. STABILIZER (4) finished 7 lengths from the winner in eighth over 1110m at Toowoomba last start after being in the firing line on the bend, a less impressive effort than his seventh at Ipswich the run before. On his best figures he is good enough to take this out. THE BOSS MAN (9) gets in well at the weights with the claim and may run a race while fresh.
